price_value.rationale: There is no fair-value estimate or comps. Profile market notes put rough drivers at $25k-$40k and solid drivers at $45k-$70k. The reserve has not been met at $26,000 and the likely hammer sits above that. mission_fit.rationale: Porsche is on the active exclusion list. The mission is a year-round, rain-capable manual daily driver. A 57-year-old ungalvanised body with disclosed rust and torn seals is a weekend classic, not a bridge, and a reserve classic auction is not easy to resell in 6-24 months.

logistics.rationale: The car is in Miami, the auction closes in about 1 day and PPI access is not stated, so a lift inspection before bidding is tight. The dealer is reachable and the car is smog-exempt for California. Transport or a fly-and-drive across the country applies.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: Several desirable 912 traits are claimed together: 1969 long-wheelbase chassis, 5-speed, 5-gauge dash, factory-colour burgundy, and 40 years with one owner. These are offset by non-original Fuchs-style wheels, a CD head unit and unconfirmed matching numbers.

evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a claimed 1969 912 coupe with 5-speed, a clean Florida title, a chassis number, 2023-dated tires, and a substantial dated 2025 refresh summarised from gallery invoices: clutch/flywheel, both main seals, brakes with fluid flush, and a carb rebuild. The dealer openly discloses rust on the passenger quarter panel and underbody components, an oil leak when very hot, torn door-jamb weatherstrip, a cracked dash and a driver's-side repaint with no stated cause. True mileage is unknown on a 5-digit odometer. Ownership between 2009 and November 2025 is undisclosed, and the current owner has had the car about a year. The decisive open items are the structural extent of the rust, COA/matching numbers, and hot engine test data, none of which were examined here. The reserve is unmet at $26,000 with roughly a day left, which leaves little time to arrange a lift inspection in Miami. Separately, Porsche sits on the buyer's active exclusion list and the car does not match the year-round rain-capable daily brief.
evidence.next_action: Message the dealer today asking for lift photos of the longitudinals and front pan, the COA and the 2025 invoices, and whether a Miami mobile PPI is possible before the November 2 close. Also confirm with Jason whether a Porsche 912 is in scope at all given the active exclusion.
